interview.name: Leo
interview.answer: The current notes do not specify the repair drive’s time or location.

reflections: Leo is the practical organizer for the repair drive and tends to answer logistics questions directly.
Hana and Oren are responsive helpers who want clear instructions before they can contribute effectively.
The group coordination is straightforward and task-focused, with Leo relaying concrete collection details to keep everyone aligned.
Leo is coordinating the repair drive and giving different people simple, specific instructions.

events.text: Leo: Hi Hana — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you first confirm what time the repair drive starts and whether you need me to bring anything specific?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Leo: I’m checking the start time now, and I’ll let you know if you need to bring anything specific.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m ready to help out, I just need a little reminder of what we’re collecting.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Leo: We’re collecting tools, tape, batteries, and any spare parts people can donate.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Oren: Got it—tools, tape, batteries, and spare parts. I’ll spread the word and see what folks can bring over.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Leo: It starts at 10 a.m., and just bring the tools, tape, batteries, or spare parts you can spare.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Kira: Perfect — I’ll be there at 10 at your place with the tool kit.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Leo: Great, thanks — see you at 10.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Leo: I’m checking the start time now, and I’ll let you know if you need to bring anything specific.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo—just let me know the time when you have it, and I’ll be ready.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Quinn: I’m still gathering the repair-drive details, and I can put you on the invite list too. If you know what needs fixing first, send it my way and I’ll spread it around.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: I’m still checking on the first stop for the repair drive, but I can definitely keep you on the invite list. If you hear what needs fixing first, send it my way and I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Cleo: Hi Leo — I’m keeping an eye out for screws, duct tape, and spare paint for the repair drive. If you need anything else tracked, just let me know.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Cleo — that’s perfect. I don’t need anything else tracked right now.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I find any of those supplies.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — I’m checking the start time now, and I’ll let you know if there’s anything specific to bring.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Leo — it’s on Sunday at the community center now. Let me know if you need the updated list or supplies.
events.speaker: Rosa
